Name: Witchy Hats for Json Assets
Author: contrarequiallas
Description:
i was a big fan of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/612]7yrsofbadluck[/url]'s witch hats, so i decided to edit some of my own.
they definitely deserve the majority of the credit for the creation of mine.


for the most current version you will need [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]. this wonderful conversion comes to you as courtesy of the fabulous user [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9781208]Rockin132[/url]﻿.


house mod used in the screencaps can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2030]here[/url], though it is now obsolete. i highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51171631]Gweniaczek[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]medieval buildings[/url] mod as a replacement.
though now unsupported, if you want to use the content patcher version keep in mind that using more than one mod that alters the hats.xnb will cause conflicts, so only use one. [b]provided it doesn't infringe on another mod author's intent[/b] for the use of their mod, you're welcome to make your own edits to your hats.xnb files to merge mine with another.

as of nov.27.2020 i have plans to add more hats that i started in the height of my patch 1.4 euphoria, but then couldn't finish before adhd hyperfixation train lead me astray roflmao. provided i don't drop off the face of the earth again i hope to have them added by december.

Downloads.Description: conversion courtesy of rockin132, originals courtesy 7yrsbadluck. you will need json assets and spacecore for it to function. this will allow it to add the hats in as new items rather than swap preexisting hats as per the content patcher edition.
